entities.name: José Rodríguez de la Oliva
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Rodríguez de la Oliva  was a Spanish sculptor of the 18th-century from San Cristóbal de La Laguna, Tenerife. He was one of the most important sculptors of the Canary Islands. He was known as "El Moño".
